newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ross sees slight drop in gold output.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ross sees slight drop in gold output.

text.p: Australia-based resources company Ross Mining NL said on Thursday it produced 19,456 ounces of gold in the December quarter, down slightly from the 20,197 ounces produced in the previous quarter.
Ross said it realised an average gold price of A$529 an ounce in the latest quarter versus A$555 reported in the previous quarter.
Ross said it had 54,146 ounces hedged at the end of December at an average weighted price of A$561 an ounce.
Good progress has been made in the development of the Gold Ridge gold mine project in the Solomon Islands and the Timbarra project in Australia during the quarter, Ross said.
